# Caw&Co

> Caw&Co is a self-hosted control plane for Claude Code, OpenCode and pi. One browser board shows every machine, project and session, and you answer the ones that are waiting.

Caw&Co puts a small daemon on each of your machines. Each daemon reports to a hub on your own network, a tailnet or a LAN, and the hub is never bound to a public address. One browser tab then shows every session on every machine.

It runs Claude Code, OpenCode and pi side by side. It runs on macOS and on Linux with systemd. You sign in to each agent with your own account; Caw&Co doesn't sell model usage.

Install it on your first machine with:

    curl -fsSL https://cawco.dev/install.sh | sh

To add another machine, use Add machine in the dashboard instead of running this command again.

## What it does

- One board: every session on every machine is a row under its project, and its delegates fold open under it. A workflow chains steps, checks and questions, and its run shows each step the same way.
- Phone approvals: when an agent stops at a permission prompt, the prompt arrives in Telegram with Allow, Always allow and Deny.
- Rules: a rule watches what every session says and sends your reply when a phrase or a regular expression matches. With Jev connected it can match by meaning. You can narrow a rule to one machine, project, agent or model.
- Delegates: a session can hand work to another session on any machine in the fleet, on any agent. A delegate has its own session and its own clone, and it is done when its parent's checks pass.
- Fleet sync: add a skill, an MCP server or a plugin marketplace once on the hub and every machine gets it. Memory and hooks sync too.
- Message queue: send a message while the agent works. It waits its turn, and you can take it back until it's read.
- Continue in a new session: the hub summarises a long conversation with a model you pick and opens a fresh session from it, on any agent or model.
- Hand off with a cost check: sessions message each other across machines. If the target Claude Code session's prompt cache has expired, the hub refuses the first try and says a fresh delegate is usually cheaper.
- Spend: see what each agent cost today, against a budget you set.

## Pricing

The hub, the daemon and the board are free. You run them on your own machines.

A native app for iPhone, iPad and Mac will cost $9.99, paid once, with no trial. It is not released yet.
